values.website: A rugged industrial gateway on MT7628 with 4G, Wi-Fi 4, RS485, RS232, digital I/O, analog input, RTC, and a wide 9–30V DC input. Built for smart energy automation, industrial process monitoring, and remote environmental and field monitoring.
values.catalogue: A rugged industrial gateway on MT7628 with 4G, Wi-Fi 4, RS485, RS232, digital I/O, analog input, RTC, and a wide 9–30V DC input. Built for smart energy automation, industrial process monitoring, and remote environmental and field monitoring.

Single 4G MODEM
1+1 LAN+WAN

Wi-Fi 4 2.4 GHz

Made in India
4G LTE
Wi-Fi 4

values.website:
Smart Energy & Utility Automation
Industrial Process Monitoring

values.catalogue:
Smart Energy & Utility Automation — Ideal for connecting energy meters, RTUs, and utility equipment using RS485/RS232 interfaces for real-time monitoring and data transmission.
Industrial Process Monitoring — Can be deployed in factories to collect sensor and machine data through DIO and analogue inputs for process control and predictive maintenance
Remote Environmental & Field Monitoring — Suitable for monitoring weather stations, water pumps, agricultural systems, and other field assets requiring rugged and uninterrupted connectivity
